Priya (Finance): Heads up: Azure Marketplace invoice shows several lines billed to our reseller pool but missing partner mapping. We need to resolve before EOM.

Omar (Billing): Which invoice? Can you paste a sample line?

Priya (Finance): INV-AZ-2028-03-05. Sample: `marketplace:eu-west-1:reseller-vertex:meter-txn  Units: 450  Charge: 3,210.00USD  metadata: {}` — metadata empty.

Jules (Partner Ops): Vertex claims they send partner_account_id, but our parser expects partner_id. Might be a key rename on their side.

Ken (Eng): Quick grep of the ingestion shows keys partner_account_id and partner_id both used historically. Current transform only checks `partner_id`. I'll add a fallback to accept `partner_account_id`.

recon-bot: Automated scan: Unallocated Azure marketplace charges = $3,210.00 (1 line) on INV-AZ-2028-03-05. Suggest re-run transform or manual journal.

Omar (Billing): If Eng can reprocess that day we can auto-assign. Otherwise we'll need a manual chargeback to Vertex. Manual journal requires Priya sign-off.

Priya (Finance): Approve manual allocation up to $3.5k if reprocess fails. Tag with "mp-reseller-temp" and reference invoice.

Ken (Eng): I'll deploy a small patch now and kick off a reprocess for 03-04 to 03-06. ETA 40m.

recon-bot: Reprocess complete (job rp-9001). Result: line now contains partner_id=vertex-998, allocation applied. Unallocated remaining = $0.00. Link: https://billing.internal/recon/INV-AZ-2028-03-05/rp-9001

Jules (Partner Ops): Vertex confirmed partner_account_id was the new field; they've rolled a fix upstream. Sending them the log snippet.

Priya (Finance): Great, closing this one. Please add a short note to the finance runbook about expecting either `partner_id` or `partner_account_id` keys on marketplace payloads.

Ken (Eng): Will add runbook entry and a unit test for both keys.

Omar (Billing): Marking invoice reconciled and moving to month-close folder.

Priya (Finance): Thanks all. :white_check_mark:
